nodes.label: mcathcat Cloud Run Service
nodes.rationale: A Knative/Cloud Run service manifest for the app under the name 'mcathcat', applied via `gcloud run services replace`. Stale artifact: the project's deployment target is Vercel and Cloud Run was removed in the deployment cleanup.

nodes.label: Container Health Probe (/api/health)
nodes.rationale: Startup and liveness probes both GET /api/health on port 8080. No such route exists under src/app/api/, so this probe references an endpoint the codebase does not implement.

nodes.label: Cloud Run Autoscaling & Resource Policy
nodes.rationale: Scale-to-zero (minScale 0, maxScale 10) with 2 vCPU / 2Gi memory, containerConcurrency 80 and a 300s timeout — a cost-minimising configuration that accepts cold starts.
